script.text: The electricity bill was so high last month. 지난달 전기세가 너무 많이 나왔어.
It's the AC, but I can't stand the heat. 에어컨 때문이긴 한데, 더운 건 못 참겠어.
Can't we at least turn it off at night? 밤에라도 좀 끄면 안 될까?
I can't fall asleep when it's humid. 습하면 잠이 안 온단 말이야.
Of course we will see. 그래, 두고 보자.
We can't do that. 그렇게는 못 해.
The electricity bill is so high. 전기세가 너무 많이 나온다니까.
